description.p: Pepper opens one image and gets out of the way: no toolbar, no library, just the picture and a status bar you can hide. Everything else lives in the right-click menu, including Preferences, where the window can turn translucent with KWin's blur behind it.

ul.li: Opens anything Qt and KDE's image plugins can read, including WebP, AVIF, JPEG XL, TIFF, PSD and SVG
Plays animated GIF and WebP, and draws SVGs sharp even when they fill the screen
Zoom with the wheel or the keys, actual size, fit to window, and drag to pan
Opens images at fit, shrink-to-fit or actual size, optionally resizing the window to match
Fullscreen, and a minimal mode that hides the status bar
Opens files dragged onto the window, and says why one won't open instead of closing

screenshot.caption: An illustration, with its size and zoom in the status bar
